title: Leon Kennedy's fate at the end of Resident Evil Requiem
subject: leon
description:
Would you have destroyed Elpis or kept it? 👇

Leon S. Kennedy's infection and the ending of Resident Evil Requiem. Major spoilers for Resident Evil Requiem.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Leon Kennedy finally met a virus he couldn't outrun.
In Resident Evil Requiem, he's investigating deaths tied to bioweapons.
He crosses paths with Grace Ashcroft, an FBI analyst haunted by her mother's death.
Then the hunter becomes the patient. Leon is infected with the T-virus, and his body starts failing.
His only hope is Elpis, a cure. Destroy it, and Leon dies. Keep it, and he can be saved.
In the canon ending, the cure saves him. In the final scene, Leon wears a wedding ring.
